thread:
Nora A: Planning the Spruce customer VPC rollforward. Proposed window: Wed 03/25 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need deploy lead, DB migration owner, smoke test checklist, and rollback readiness. Who can be online?

Kevin L: I can lead the deploy. Will be present for the whole window. Plan: canary on 1 node, run smoke, then roll to remaining nodes. PR #4281 (vpc-config) is merged, CI green.

Samir R: I'll own the DB side. Migration is additive (index + new column), should be fast but will run with a brief maintenance flag. I’ll prepare a backout that drops the migration if needed.

Jordan P: I'll write a short runbook — quick checklist items: kube manifests applied, customer certs loaded, peering verified, iptables rules sanity. Also need to confirm SRE tracing/metrics tags for the run.

Shiv K: Rollback plan: if the canary fails, route traffic to hosted fallback (redwood-hosted/spruce-fallback), revert CRs to previous manifest, and roll back DB if bad. We should ensure TTL-based cache invalidation is set so we don't serve stale KV cache after rollback.

Nora A: @Elena M (Spruce POC) notified and ok with the window. Elena, can you confirm someone from their infra team will be available for quick testing?

Elena M: Spruce can have one engineer on standby. They'll test application connectivity and sample inference calls. They asked for a 30-min heads-up before the canary.

deploy-bot: Deployment slot reserved: slot-6427 (Wed 03/25 02:00-04:00 UTC). Please tag updates in this thread.

Jordan P: Smoke test commands (quick):
```
# verify kube rollout and endpoint
kubectl rollout status deploy/spruce-inference -n spruce || exit 1
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://spruce.vpc.svc/api/v1/predict -d '{"input":"hello"}' | jq .
# check metrics
curl -s http://metrics.internal:9090/metrics | grep spruce_inference_request_count
```

Kevin L: I'll run the canary on node-3, run Jordan's smoke tests, then declare green. We should also run an end-to-end inference with a long context to validate KV cache behavior.

Samir R: DB migration checklist: 
- preflight: snapshot + perf check
- migration (non-blocking) with maintenance flag
- validate row counts and indexes
- rollback script ready (restore snapshot + drop column)

Shiv K: One more ops note: customers' client cert needs to be loaded into the edge proxies before the canary. Jordan, can you confirm where the certs live?

Jordan P: Certs are in vault:path/spruce/certs, I’ll push to the secret-agent and confirm TTL.

Nora A: Escalation: if we hit < 70% success rate on canary for 10m, escalate to on-call (pager) and run rollback. Kevin you'll call it?

Kevin L: Yep. I'll call the rollback and trigger hosted fallback if needed. I'll also update the incident channel if we trip the rollback. :thumbsup:

Elena M: Spruce engineer will be available from 01:50 UTC. They asked for the exact canary IP once it's up.

Jordan P: I'll post canary IP here when allocated and paste the small checklist that on-call can follow.

Nora A: Summary checklist (final):
- [ ] Kevin lead — present 02:00-04:00 UTC
- [ ] Samir DB owner + rollback script ready
- [ ] Jordan runbook + smoke tests in this thread
- [ ] Shiv rollback steps and hosted fallback verified
- [ ] Elena + Spruce engineer notified and on standby (01:50 UTC)
- [ ] deploy-bot slot confirmed
- [ ] Certs pushed to secret-agent

If all good, we'll lock the window. Reply with :eyes: to confirm availability.
